regions.contentLimits: One label and two navigation actions.
One row per scene with a thumbnail, title, status badge, order, and four row actions.
regions.overflow: Titles truncate; row actions never wrap under the thumbnail.

regions.contentLimits: One title and one MP4 upload. The cover is derived from the first frame of the video and is not a separate input.
regions.overflow: One column. The cover preview sits beside its explanation and wraps below it when narrow.

regions.contentLimits: One embedded stage in compact mode.
regions.overflow: The preview is clipped to its card.

regions.contentLimits: One confirmation at a time with a named target.

responsive.compact: Catalog, form, and preview stack in one column; form fields are one column.
responsive.wide: Catalog and form sit side by side; the preview spans the full width below them.

focus.onOpen: A confirmation dialog moves focus into itself and traps it.
focus.onClose: Focus returns to the row action that opened the dialog.
focus.onError: The save result region announces the message; focus stays on the save action.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the admin task, then one h2 per card region.
accessibility.labels: Both inputs have a visible label. The derived cover preview has descriptive alternative text.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Save and delete results are announced through a polite live region.
